name: Star Beckoner

alignment.name: Evil
alignment.description:
Evil creatures don’t necessarily go out of their way to hurt people, but they’re perfectly willing to take advantage of the weakness of others to acquire what they want.
	Evil creatures use rules and order to maximize personal gain. They don’t care whether laws hurt other people. They support institutional structures that give them power, even if that power comes at the expense of others’ freedom. Slavery and rigid caste structures are not only acceptable but desirable to evil creatures, as long as they are in a position to benefit from them.

description: This is the size of a typical human and serves as a standard in the game. This category has no special rules.

traits.name: Threatening Reach
traits.details: The beckoner can make opportunity attacks against enemies within 2 squares of it.

powers.name: Tentacle
powers.requirements: The beckoner must have fewer than two creatures grabbed.
powers.description: One of the beckoner’s grabs persists, and the creature on which the grab persists takes 2d10 + 13 damage.

powers.name: Tentacle Flurry
powers.requirements: The beckoner must have no creature grabbed.

effect.description: The beckoner calls forth up to three star wisps, which appear within 5 squares of the beckoner and act immediately after it in the initiative order. The star wisps remain until destroyed or until the beckoner takes a minor action to dispel them. A beckoner can have no more than three star wisps present at a given time.
